title: Security Room Surveillance
description: A dimly lit security office desk features multiple vintage CRT monitors displaying black and white footage of empty institutional hallways and stairwells. An open drawer reveals a flashlight, keys, and a handwritten note reading 'If the painting moves, do not follow it,' next to a lit green banker's lamp and a steaming 'World's Okayest Boss' mug.
prompt: A tense security monitoring room with multiple old CRT televisions showing black and white footage of endless empty hallways and staircases, vintage wooden desk with an open drawer containing a flashlight, set of keys, and a note saying 'If the painting moves, do not follow it', green banker's lamp casting warm light, steaming coffee mug, cigarette smoke, keys and papers scattered, pinned photos and maps on the wall, ominous red exit sign in background, moody cinematic lighting, eerie atmosphere
